title: Assam Brahmaputra Valley Monsoon Flooding
description: Severe inundation across 28 districts due to rising water levels in the Brahmaputra and tributaries, affecting over 1.2 million residents.

title: Severe Cyclonic Storm Dana - Odisha Coastline
description: Cyclonic system making landfall between Dhamra and Bhitarkanika with sustained winds of 100-110 km/h and localized storm surge.

title: Kerala Wayanad Debris Flow and Inundation
description: Catastrophic cloudburst triggering extensive landslides, flash flooding, and mudslides along Chaliyar river basin.

title: Bihar Kosi River Embankment Breach Floods
description: Water discharge exceeding 600,000 cusecs causing widespread submergence in Supaul, Saharsa, and Khagaria districts.

title: M4.5 Earthquake - Kangra District, Himachal Pradesh
description: Moderate shallow tectonic tremor felt across Kangra, Mandi, and Dharamshala; no major structural collapses reported.
